question: What does one make when the mind becomes one-pointed in meditation?
premises: kurute bahudhā rūpaṃ means makes form in many ways
dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ means mind gone one-pointed in meditation
inference: One makes form in many ways when the mind becomes one-pointed in meditation.
plain_english: He makes form in many ways when the mind becomes one-pointed in meditation.
